summary: One-frame event raised when a projectile impact can be interrupted (reactions such as Shield / Deflect Missiles): the hits it would deal, the spell, an entity and the impact position. Read by esv::interrupt::EventSystem::ProcessInterruptionEvents (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x10E0910; its WorldView lists this component). Seen.py context: fights with ranged enemies (gnoll rangers, minotaur bait), traps on locked chests/doors.

fields.name: Hit
fields.evidence: Element destructor in bg3.exe+0x22E3E00 (stride 0x1E8) calls FUN_1405f19c0 (~ eoc::HitDesc::~HitDesc, pseudo-code match) on element+0: an eoc::HitDesc copy (Script Extender type, not redeclared here).

fields.name: field_1C0
fields.evidence: Element destructor clears (FUN_1405bd630) and frees the buffer at +0x1C0: a container (pointer, then capacity/size).

fields.name: OriginatorPrototype
fields.evidence: Same members as Script Extender's SpellId (Base/ExposedTypes.h, 0x38 bytes). Creator default -1.

fields.name: Hits
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2AE5990 zeroes +0 and the dwords +8/+0xC; destructor bg3.exe+0x22B8270 calls FUN_1422e3e00(this, 0) (resize to 0: element stride 0x1E8, each holding a HitDesc) and frees *(this+0). Live: heap pointer, capacity 1..0x10, size 1..0xE.

fields.name: Spell
fields.evidence: Destructor calls eoc::spell::SpellId::~SpellId(this+0x10); creator writes -1 at +0x10 and +0x40 (the two FixedStrings), 0x17 at +0x18 (SourceType Sentinel) and zeroes +0x20..+0x3F. Equals Script Extender's SpellId (0x38 bytes). Live: +0x10 and +0x40 hold the same FixedString index (OriginatorPrototype == Prototype).

fields.name: field_48
fields.evidence: Creator default 0xFFC0000000000000 (null entity). Live entity handles (e.g. 0x1819C / 0x0200000A) or null. Probably the projectile or its caster; not established.

fields.name: field_50
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes qword +0x50 and dword +0x58. Live world coordinates (146.8, 29.2, 10.26), probably the impact position.

fields.name: _Pad5C
fields.evidence: Not written by the creator; live garbage.

open_questions: Members of the 0x1E8 hit element beyond the HitDesc at +0 (container at +0x1C0, tail); role of the entity at +0x48.
field_48 / field_50: the system that drains it (projectile impact interrupt) would show whether they are the projectile or caster and the impact position.
